title: Arrow of Arcane Interference
summary: Deals weapon damage, breaks the target’s Concentration and applies Silenced. Silenced prevents verbal spellcasting and gives Thunder immunity. The silence ticks down at the start of the target’s turn.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Deals weapon damage, breaks the target’s Concentration and applies Silenced. Silenced prevents verbal spellcasting and gives Thunder immunity. The silence ticks down at the start of the target’s turn.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Interrupt a spell the enemy is already concentrating on.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Silenced: The target cannot speak or cast verbal spells. The timer ticks at the start of its turn, so the arrow’s silence can prevent reaction spells before that turn.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
